title: ControlPlaneObservabilityEvent
description: One JSONL line in QUEUE_ROOT/observability/events.jsonl. Append-only; never rewrite history.

at.description: UTC RFC3339 timestamp of the event

task_id.description: Durable/runtime task id. Empty string allowed for seat-only or project-level events (auth, seat heartbeat).

type.description: question / spec_maintainer added by SPEC §17.8; architecture_review by §19.10; docs_audit by §21; gate / runner by §23.7; architect by §19; run, review, verify, allowance and plane by §23.2; suite by §14.1; prefer by §10.4 (ccp tasks prefer); hold by §10.4 (ccp tasks hold); sign_off by §3.5 (ccp tasks sign-off: stage, by, words, head); hosting is historical (Grok hosting, removed 2026-11-05): old ledger rows carry it, nothing writes it and readers skip it

payload.description: Type/op-specific fields. Extra keys allowed for forward compat. No secrets.
